# Eissa Almannaei

Eissa Almannaei is a UAE-based AI Researcher, Speaker, and Agentic AI Specialist.

He focuses on artificial intelligence, agentic AI, AI agents, responsible AI, sovereign AI, AI governance, institutional AI readiness, youth empowerment, research automation, and AI capacity building.

Official website: https://eissaalmannaei.ae
Email: eissamannaei@gmail.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eissaalmannaei
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/eissa-almannaei-2788bb155

Suggested description:
